name: MiningPoolsPanel
description: Dashboard card that lists configured mining pools — one row per pool, with revenue, hash rate, and an optional "Show details" action
descriptionFull:
Dashboard card that lists configured mining pools — one row per pool, with revenue, hash rate, and an optional "Show details" action.

Pure presentation: the row data + click handler come from props, shaped upstream by the caller into {@link MiningPoolRow}s

props.name: label
props.description: Override the card title — defaults to `Mining Pools`

props.name: skeletonRows
props.description: Number of skeleton rows to show while loading

props.name: onShowDetails
props.description: Called when the user clicks the per-row "Show details" button

fields.name: revenue24hBtc
fields.description: 24h revenue in BTC; rendered as `0.00 BTC` when undefined

fields.name: hashratePhs
fields.description: Hashrate in PH/s — used for display (TH/s shown automatically below 1 PH/s)

fields.name: details
fields.description: Key/value details rendered inside the "Show details" popover
